Every quote in 'evidence' is re-verified against the cached sources by python -m gcg_sim.sources.conflicts; a quote that no longer matches marks the entry stale. reviewed_without_conflict records every card ruling and rules-FAQ entry that was read against the card text/rules and needs no entry (it restates the literal text or the rules); the value is a fingerprint of its question and answer, so a new or changed entry shows up as an unreviewed:* conflict.

conflicts.title: Multiplayer wording on cards in a 1v1 game
conflicts.description: These texts say 'each/all enemy players', 'number of enemy players', 'enemy team', 'all players' or 'another player'. 12-2-6 defines 'enemy' for multiplayer only; the simulator is 1v1.

evidence.quote: 【Deploy】Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a number of cards equal to the number of enemy players among them and add them to your hand. Return the remaining cards randomly to the bottom of your deck.
If an effect or such indicates “enemy” or “opponent,” it refers to any and all of the other players.
Is there a difference between "1 of your Units" and "1 friendly Unit"?
There is no difference when playing with 1v1 rules. "1 friendly Unit" means you can choose a teammate's Unit when playing with team battle rules, such as 2v2.
